subject: Invoice submission: multi-format attachments, PO matching and portal vs email
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <ap@nebula-analytics.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurements@nebula-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice submission options and file format questions

Hi Alex / Marissa,

We're kicking off vendor onboarding for Nebula and want to confirm Redwood's preferred invoice submission workflow. A few quick questions from our AP automation team: 

- Do you require submission via the vendor portal or is invoicing by email to ap@redwoodinference.com an approved fallback?
- We generate invoices as multi-page PDFs and occasionally bundle them as a single ZIP for batch uploads. Will that be accepted by the portal? Any file-size limits?
- How strict is PO matching? For example, will a single invoice referencing multiple POs (separate line items per PO) be auto-applied or routed to exceptions?

I've attached our standard vendor_onboarding_form.pdf to speed up the setup. We're open to SFTP drops if that simplifies integration.

TIA,
Elena Ruiz
AP Manager
Nebula Analytics
(attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <ap@nebula-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission options and file format questions

Hi Elena — thanks for the details and the onboarding form, that's helpful. Quick answers and a couple of requests so we can avoid exceptions: 

- Preferred path: portal first (portal.redwoodinference.com/vendors). Portal gives better unit-cost routing and automatic PO matching. Email ingestion (ap@redwoodinference.com) is supported as a fallback for vendors who cannot use the portal.
- File formats: portal accepts single PDFs and multi-page PDFs (no problem). ZIP uploads are accepted but treated as "batch import" and require an index.csv inside the ZIP that maps each file to account/PO metadata. File-size limit for portal batch uploads: 200 MB per ZIP. Individual PDF limit: 25 MB.
- PO matching rules: Our engine matches at the PO-line level. Single invoices referencing multiple POs are supported, but each PO line must include the PO number on the invoice line (or be enumerated in the invoice metadata). If metadata is missing, the item goes to exceptions for manual review. 

Two asks: 
1) Can you populate the attached sample_invoice_template.xlsx when you submit a first batch? That helps automated mapping.
2) If you plan to send batches via ZIP or SFTP, please include an index.csv with columns: invoice_filename, invoice_number, total_amount, currency, list_of_po_numbers (pipe-separated), vendor_account_code.

I'll loop in Karthik to confirm whether we can relax automatic matching tolerance for your first 60 days to reduce manual touch.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
(attachment: sample_invoice_template.xlsx)

--
Alex Martinez
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com

From: Elena Ruiz <ap@nebula-analytics.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurements@nebula-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission options and file format questions

Alex — thanks, that level of detail is perfect. A couple follow-ups from our automation team: 

- We can produce the index.csv as requested. Confirming the expected delimiter is a comma and that pipe-separated PO lists are okay in that column.
- For SFTP: do you provide a vendor-specific SFTP endpoint or do vendors drop to a shared bucket with subfolders? What authentication method do you prefer (SSH key or username/password)?
- On PO matching: our system stamps the PO number on the PDF header but doesn't populate line-level PO numbers by default. For the initial ramp, will Redwood allow invoices where the PO is listed only at the header level (not per-line)? If not, we can produce per-line metadata but it will add engineering time.

We can do an initial low-volume ZIP drop to test the workflow next week if that works. Attaching our onboarding form again in case anything else is needed.

Thanks,
Elena
(attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <ap@nebula-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Decision log: Nebula invoice onboarding (portal + email fallback)

Karthik / Marissa — putting the final recommendation here so the vendor onboarding team can proceed and we have an audit trail for exceptions. Elena is cc'd so she sees the plan. 

Summary decision (approved):
- Primary method: Redwood Vendor Portal (portal.redwoodinference.com) — enable Nebula Analytics account and provide portal onboarding link.
- Fallback method: Email ingestion to ap@redwoodinference.com for rare exceptions (concurrency limit: 10 emails/day until onboarding complete).
- Batch uploads: Accept ZIP bundles with index.csv per Alex's spec (200 MB max). For early ramp (first 60 days), set PO-matching tolerance to header-level match allowed; escalate only if header-level PO fails to match to a single open PO. After day 60, require line-level or index.csv PO mapping for full automation.
- SFTP: Provide shared SFTP drop with vendor-specific subfolder; authentication via SSH key only.

Action items: 
- Marissa: create vendor portal account and send activation link to Elena by EOD Wed 2026-11-18. (assigned)
- Karthik: configure temporary header-level-match tolerance for Nebula in the invoice engine and document exception criteria. (assigned)
- Alex: share sample_invoice_template.xlsx and onboarding checklist link with Elena.

Elena — I will send your activation link once Marissa creates the account. If you can confirm the public SSH key for your SFTP identity, Karthik will provision the subfolder.

Thanks — Alex
